items.title: Hackers Can Hijack Claude Code MCP Traffic to Steal OAuth Tokens
items.description: A five-step attack chain that silently redirects Claude Code’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) traffic through attacker-controlled infrastructure, intercepting OAuth bearer tokens that grant persistent, broadly scoped access to connected SaaS platforms like Jira, Confluence, and GitHub with no patch incoming from Anthropic.
